print(f"Optimal chelator dose: {optimal_dose:.1f}")
print(f"Predicted optimal titer: {optimal_titer:.1f}")

print("\n=== TURBIDITY vs TITER (excluding feed-cut baseline) ===")
valid = df.dropna(subset=['turbidity'])
